_comment: OPTIONAL. If this file is absent the dashboard reads RPC credentials
straight out of ~/.wam/wam.conf, which install.sh generates. In the normal
case there is nothing to configure -- just run `node server.js`.
Copy to config.json only if you need to override something.
_bind: 127.0.0.1 keeps the dashboard local. Change to 0.0.0.0 ONLY behind a TLS reverse proxy.
